# Metadata

Combine metadata from all three panels into a single file. 

## Tumor panel 

```{r}
sce_tumor <- readRDS("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")
```

```{r}
metadata_tumor <- colData(sce_tumor) %>% as.data.frame %>% select("sample_id", "width_px", "height_px", "PID", "TMA", "gender", "age", "age_bin", "type", "subtype_combined", "status_OS", "OS_months", "lymphocytes_combined", "pT_combined", "ISUP_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score") %>% unique()
```

# Combine information 

## Metadata general 

```{r}
# Read in external metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(patient_meta$grid,"x",patient_meta$x,"y",patient_meta$y),"NA","")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "x","X")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "y","Y")
patient_meta[is.na(patient_meta$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data

# Re-group subtypes 
patient_meta$subtype_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), patient_meta$subtype, "other")
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

# Filter for ccRCC cases and primary tumors
patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary" & subtype_combined == "ccRCC")

## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
patient_meta$pT_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$pT_simple))

### ISUP grade 
patient_meta$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$ISUP))

patient_meta$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", patient_meta$lymphocytes)

## Update survival censoring
patient_meta$status_OS <- ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

patient_meta$OS_months <- patient_meta$survival_months

# Add PDL1 score
## Based on T cell panel derived PDL1 score
patient_meta$PDL1_score <- metadata_Tcell$PDL1_score[match(patient_meta$PID, metadata_Tcell$PID)]
```

```{r}
metadata_general <- patient_meta %>% filter(subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% select("PID", "TMA", "gender", "age", "age_bin", "type", "subtype_combined", "status_OS", "OS_months", "lymphocytes_combined", "pT_combined", "ISUP_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")
```

### Add genomic and metabolic subtype 

```{r}
# Genomic info
metadata_general$genomic_subtype <- genomic_select$genomic_subtype[match(metadata_general$PID, genomic_select$PID)]
metadata_general$genomic_risk <- genomic_select$genomic_risk[match(metadata_general$PID, genomic_select$PID)]

# Metabolic info
metadata_general$metabolic_subtype <- metabolic_select$metabolic_subtype[match(metadata_general$PID, metabolic_select$PID)]
metadata_general$metabolic_subtype_name <- metabolic_select$metabolic_subtype_name[match(metadata_general$PID, metabolic_select$PID)]
```

### Add survival censoring 

```{r}
# Option 1: All patients
surv_select <- metadata_general #%>% filter(status_OS == "1")
surv_select$surv_censoring <- ifelse(surv_select$OS_months >= median(surv_select$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE), "long", "short")

## Surv
library(survival)
library(survminer)
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ surv_censoring, data = surv_select)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          #palette = c("grey", "#ABCFE5", "#3787C0", "#08306B")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
          )

## Add to patient metadata
metadata_general$surv_censor_all <- surv_select$surv_censoring[match(metadata_general$PID, surv_select$PID)]

# Option 2: Filter for patients with a survival event
surv_select <- metadata_general %>% filter(status_OS == "1")
surv_select$surv_censoring <- ifelse(surv_select$OS_months >= median(surv_select$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE), "long", "short")

# Surv
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ surv_censoring, data = surv_select)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          #palette = c("grey", "#ABCFE5", "#3787C0", "#08306B")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
          )

## Add to patient metadata
metadata_general$surv_censor_event <- surv_select$surv_censoring[match(metadata_general$PID, surv_select$PID)]
```

### Add panel info 

```{r}
## IMC data analysis
# Available in specific panel
metadata_general$PID_in_tumor <- metadata_general$PID %in% metadata_tumor$PID
metadata_general$PID_in_myeloid <- metadata_general$PID %in% metadata_myeloid$PID
metadata_general$PID_in_Tcell <- metadata_general$PID %in% metadata_Tcell$PID

# Available across all panels (n=490)
metadata_general$PID_in_all <- metadata_general$PID_in_tumor & metadata_general$PID_in_myeloid & metadata_general$PID_in_Tcell
```

### Save 

```{r}
write_csv(metadata_general, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/projects/RCC_DL/metadata_general.csv")
```
